title: decision: consent endpoints answer 404 for an unknown local user
description: protocol-06 §5.7 allows 404 (unknown) or 201 (hide existence). Mark 2026-11-02 chose 404: requestConsent whose targetUri, or updateConsent whose requesterUri, is not a known local user. Known = has at least one client (store clients_of_user non-empty), the same rule keyMaterial uses (follower/key_packages.rs, decision .7.9), so both endpoints agree. Trade-off accepted: a peer can learn whether a user exists.
